query:
INSERT INTO artifact_analysis (digest, ecosystem, name, version, unreadable)
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
            ON CONFLICT (digest) DO UPDATE SET
                ecosystem   = EXCLUDED.ecosystem,
                name        = EXCLUDED.name,
                version     = EXCLUDED.version,
                unreadable  = EXCLUDED.unreadable,
                analysed_at = now()
            RETURNING id
